name: github-pr
description: Open a GitHub pull request for the job branch or move it to the job's target branch.
script:
set -eu
repo="$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_OWNER/$PECORE_PROJECT_REPO_NAME"
draft=$(jq -ce '.pull_request')
title=$(printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -er '.title')
url=$(gh pr list --repo "$repo" --head "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH" --json url --jq '.[0].url // empty')
if [ -n "$url" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -j '.body' | gh pr edit "$url" --base "$PECORE_JOB_TARGET" --title "$title" --body-file - >/dev/null
else
  url=$(printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -j '.body' | gh pr create --repo "$repo" --base "$PECORE_JOB_TARGET" --head "$PECORE_JOB_BRANCH" --title "$title" --body-file -)
fi
printf '%s\n' "$draft" | jq -c --arg url "$url" '. + {url: $url}'
